name: Nakshatra Pada (Quarter) Reference
note: All 108 nakshatra-pada combinations (27 nakshatras x 4 padas). Each pada's navamsa_sign is computed directly from divisional.py's own d9_navamsa() at the pada's midpoint longitude - not hand-typed - so it can never drift from what the app's own D9 chart tab would show for a planet sitting at that exact degree. Every nakshatra's 4 padas cycle through Fire, Earth, Air, then Water navamsa signs in that fixed order with no exception (confirmed computationally across all 27 nakshatras before this file was generated), matching the classical teaching that a nakshatra's own core theme (see nakshatra.json, reused here rather than retyped) expresses through each of the four elements in turn across its four padas.

verification_pass.method: navamsa_sign for all 108 entries verified computationally against divisional.py's own d9_navamsa() function (the same code path the app's D9 chart tab uses) rather than derived by hand; the resulting Fire/Earth/Air/Water cycling pattern was checked to hold with zero exceptions across all 27 nakshatras before this file was written. sign_flavor phrases are standard, uncontested classical sign-temperament keywords.

user_review_pass.outcome: Not yet reviewed by the project owner - drafted and computationally cross-checked only.

items.effects: This pada falls in Taurus navamsa, giving Vishakha's own theme — determined pursuit of goals, a forked path requiring choice — a steady, sensual, resource-minded inflection.
